definitions.gloss: one matter, one case, one incident
definitions.explanation: The counter for matters, cases, incidents, or properties.

examples.japanese: ⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一件|いっけん}⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have one matter to discuss.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{一件|いっけん}⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}そう→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: Let's talk about this matter later.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問|と}い{合|あ}わせ→問い合わせ：06131_toiawase⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一件|いっけん}⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。

notes:
{一件|いっけん} is a counter for matters, cases, and incidents.

USED FOR:
- ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧: incidents, cases
- ⟦{問|と}い{合|あ}わせ→問い合わせ：06131_toiawase⟧: inquiries
- ⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧: consultations
- ⟦{案件|あんけん}→案件：13109_anken⟧: matters, projects
- ⟦{物件|ぶっけん}→物件：06743_bukken⟧: properties (real estate)
- ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧: accidents

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{一件|いっけん}: this matter/incident
- {一件|いっけん}{落着|らくちゃく}: case closed, matter settled
- {一件|いっけん}⟦につき→につき：17196_nitsuki⟧: per case/matter

COUNTING PATTERNS:
- {一件|いっけん}、{二件|にけん}、{三件|さんけん}...
- {何件|なんけん}: how many cases/matters
